tasks.label: Docker: Build Cucumber Image
tasks.detail: Builds the Docker image for Cucumber tests

tasks.label: Docker: Run Welcome from TestJeff
tasks.command: docker run --rm --env-file .env -v ${workspaceFolder}/reports:/app/reports --entrypoint npx cucumber-test cucumber-js test/features/welcome.feature --config cucumber.single.js --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --format junit:reports/junit-report.xml
tasks.detail: Runs only the welcome.feature test to verify setup from TestJeff

tasks.label: Docker: Run All Cucumber Tests
tasks.command: docker run --rm --env-file .env -v ${workspaceFolder}/reports:/app/reports --entrypoint npx cucumber-test cucumber-js test/features --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --format junit:reports/junit-report.xml
tasks.detail: Runs all Cucumber tests and saves JUnit results to the host machine
